desc: Implement segment-tree range summaries and associative merging for maximum-subarray data.
Group positions by negative value and evaluate each valid deletion by merging its remaining gap summaries in order.
Include the no-deletion maximum-subarray baseline and enforce that a deletion result is non-empty.
Establish that merging remaining gaps in order exactly represents the array after globally deleting one value.
Validate on provided examples and targeted edge cases.
